question: A new complex of India's first bio-manufacturing institute, BRIC-National Agri-Food Bio-Manufacturing Institute (BRIC-NABI), aimed at enhancing India’s agri-food sector through advanced biotechnology, was inaugurated at _____ in October 2024.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mohali**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The new complex of India’s first bio-manufacturing institute, the **BRIC-National Agri-Food Bio-Manufacturing Institute (BRIC-NABI)**, was inaugurated in **Mohali**, **Punjab**, in **October 2024**.
 
• The facility was inaugurated by the **Union Minister of State for Science and Technology**, **Dr. Jitendra Singh**, highlighting it as a milestone in India's journey toward a self-reliant **bio-economy**.
 
• **BRIC-NABI** is a specialized institute formed under the **Biotechnology Research and Innovation Council (BRIC)** by the strategic merger of two premier organizations: the **National Agri-Food Biotechnology Institute (NABI)** and the **Center of Innovative and Applied Bioprocessing (CIAB)**.
 
• The primary objective of this institute is to bridge the gap between **laboratory-scale research** and **industrial-scale bio-manufacturing**, with a specific focus on the agri-food sector</
